title: The derived dual of a perfect complex on a ringed site is perfect and involutive, with functorial identifications against internal hom and Hom in the derived category

difficulty_reason: The lemma states that the derived dual K^vee = RSheafHom(K, O) of a perfect object K is perfect, that the double dual is K, and that K^vee represents both the internal hom and the Hom functor on the derived category (statement lines 13047-13063). The proof (proof lines 13065-13133) is a locality reduction: internal hom restricts, so perfection and the two identifications may be verified after passing to a covering, where K becomes a strictly perfect complex E^bullet, and the strictly-perfect internal-hom lemma computes the dual complex termwise. H2: two reductions followed by a termwise computation, all written out.
